name: Dirty Fantasies: Master's Help
source:
Sometimes studying high-ranked magic spells can be quite challenging and can lead to a lot of frustration, which Evelyn knows from her own experience. Luckily, she has someone she can summon for help, both with the studying and the accumulated frustration...

[From [url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-masters-help]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
学习高阶魔法有时相当困难，也会积累许多挫败感，伊芙琳对此深有体会。幸好，她可以召唤某个人前来帮忙，既解决学习上的难题，也排解积压的郁闷…

[摘自[url=https://fallen-pie.itch.io/dirty-fantasies-masters-help]itch.io[/url]]
